sourceRefs.locator: U841.4 and U842.2, two camps and continued presence; U870.6, four months at Ail Cluaithe; U871.2, Áth Cliath, the leaders, 200 ships and the three groups brought back as captives; U902.2 and U917.4, the defenders driven out and Sitriuc’s entry. U980.1 and U983.2, the battle of Tara and later coalitions.

EMAP Report 7.1, printed pp. 53–55, discussion of captive-taking, trade in enslaved people at Dublin, possibilities of domestic enslavement or onward sale, and the limits of the evidence for different destinations.
Section 2.1.1–2.1.2, printed pp. 3–4. The two placenames, proposed camp by the pool, events of 902 and 917 and changing focus around the Liffey shore at Fishamble Street and Wood Quay.

note.de: Die Annalen melden, dass Amlaíb und Ímar mit Gefangenen nach Áth Cliath kamen. Sie zählen Schiffe und nennen Gruppen von Verschleppten. Was aus den einzelnen Menschen wurde, steht dort nicht.
note.en: The annals say that Amlaíb and Ímar brought captives to Áth Cliath. They count ships and name groups of people who were taken. Individual fates go unrecorded.
